summary: Iter15 tested form-builder + mission/biz-request cancel + business photos across backend + frontend + admin UI. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (PUT /admin/categories/{cat}/questions ok, 404 on unknown; /api/categories reflects update; mission cancel ok + 400 second cancel + 403 other user; biz-request cancel ok + 400 second cancel; /businesses/detail/{id} and /businesses list both expose business_photos + price_list). Frontend richieste tab renders cancel-mission-{id} and cancel-biz-{id} testIDs on pending items — however tapping them on WEB preview does NOT cancel (statuses remain pending/matched) because Alert.alert on react-native-web ignores the destructive button callback. Business-request screen shows price_list correctly; biz-photo-* gallery not shown because Francesco Franzin has empty business_photos array (seed-data, not code). Admin UI /api/admin/ui has a CSS bug: fieldsModal and docModal are visible on page load because inline style display:flex overrides .hidden { display:none } (class specificity). Once the modal is hidden manually the whole form-builder flow works end-to-end (Connect -> Categories -> Fields on Driver -> Add field iter15_note -> Save -> reopen shows persisted field and row updates to '2 fields').

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Annulla richiesta' triggers Alert.alert with buttons, but react-native-web's Alert.alert renders as a title-only window.alert and never invokes the destructive onPress callback -> cancelMission()/cancelBusinessRequest() is never called. Statuses stay pending/matched. Ref /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/richieste.tsx:77-84. Fix: replace Alert.alert with a cross-platform confirm modal, or Platform.OS==='web' branch using window.confirm().

Both modals have class='hidden' AND inline style='display:flex'. Inline style wins over the CSS class -> both modals are visible over the login screen at page load and block the Connect button. Ref /app/backend/routers/admin_web.py:170 and :193. Fix: make .hidden { display:none !important } OR remove display:flex from inline style and add it in the shown-state via JS toggling class only.

rca_of_issue:
Bug1 (admin modal): The two overlay divs (#docModal and #fieldsModal) are declared with `class="hidden"` for their default state, but also carry an inline style `display:flex` for their active/open layout. Because inline styles take precedence over class-based rules, `.hidden { display:none }` is ineffective and the modals are painted on load — this is what makes the Connect click 'fail' (it silently hits the modal's Save fields button because it also has class .primary). Repro: open /api/admin/ui in a fresh session, see the empty dialog centered on the page. Mitigation: `.hidden{display:none!important}` OR move display:flex into a separate `.show` class toggled by JS.
Bug2 (mobile cancel on web): react-native-web's Alert.alert implementation delegates to window.alert with only the title/message and drops the buttons array + their onPress handlers. The cancel handlers in richieste.tsx wrap the destructive action inside Alert.alert's 'destructive' button, so on web the destructive callback is never invoked. Repro: on web preview, tap 'Annulla richiesta' on a pending mission or biz-request; dismiss the browser alert; check /api/missions or /api/business-requests — status remains pending/matched. Mitigation: branch on Platform.OS==='web' to use window.confirm() or a custom in-app confirmation modal.
